test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECTLY paired?

options.text: Bituminous coal - Most popular coal in commercial use
Metallurgical coal - Used for smelting iron in blast furnaces
Anthracite - Lowest grade of hard coal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Anthracite - Lowest grade of hard coal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthracite - Lowest grade of hard coal**

 
 
• **​**Anthracite is actually the *highest* grade of hard coal, not the lowest.
 
• It has the highest carbon content and the lowest amount of volatile matter, making it the most efficient coal for burning.
 
• It is primarily used for heating and cooking due to its high heat output and clean burning properties.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bituminous coal is** the most popular coal in commercial use due to its versatility and high energy content.
 
• **Metallurgical coal i**s used for smelting iron in blast furnaces because it has a high carbon content and low sulfur content, which are essential for the iron-making process.
 
• **Lignite is** a low-grade brown coal with a high moisture content and low heat content.
